newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hardie to use funds on U.S. business.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hardie to use funds on U.S. business.

text.p: Building products group James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Friday that the US$130 million raised from the sale of its global irrigation business would be used to expand its fibre cement building products operations, particularly in the United States.
Toro Co said earlier it had bought the U.S.-based irrigation business, describing the purchase as a good fit with its current lawn and garden products operations.
James Hardie managing director Keith Barton said the sale was consistent with the company's strategy of focussing on building products. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
